description: The chat plays sandbox worker checks in for the person it works for on OpenVibe.Live (Agent Streams S6): POST /api/streams/agent/:id/plays/worker. Only a first-party service token whose principal holds this capability may register one, and it names the person in X-OV-Subject, who must own the stream. The owner's own session, a desk ticket (wpt_) and a person token are refused: an owner who could register a worker would declare their own unisolated machine a sandbox, and the gate would mean nothing. The body is live.agent-sandbox-worker-request@1, the worker's own report; Live requires isolation to say exactly host_network false, credentials false, profile false, egress_proxy true and workspace 'ephemeral', and refuses a worker that does not. Health comes only from a check-in within the last minute; Live stores no endpoint, never calls the worker and never accepts an isolation code it cannot read. The capability is internal because no person or app calls it: OpenVibe.Codes' sandbox worker holds it through its own Network service client for the audience openvibe.live.
